4:24: tilawin ijewoen, kkes ed taklatin nnwen. D Ṛebbi i wen Iuran. Iḥell awen, deffir waya, a ţţezhum s wayla nnwen, s lewqama, mačči s lemḍeṛṛa. Tid, segsent, ukud tezham, fket asent arrazen nnsent, d aḥeţţem. Ur illi uɣilif fellawen deg wayen iɣef temwafaqem, deffir uḥeţţem. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
4:25: Wid, segwen, ur nezmir ara ad aɣen tiḥuṛiyn iumnen, ad aɣen si teklatin nnwen, tid iumnen. Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Iẓṛa liman nnwen. Wa seg wa. Aɣet ţent, s tsriḥ n twacult nnsent, fket asent arrazen nnsent, s lqanun. D tizedganin, mačči d tucmitin, neɣ d tid iffɣen abrid. ṢMa uɣalent d tiḥuṛiyn, sinna xedment lɛaṛ, aɛaqeb nnsent azgen n win n tiḥuṛiyn. Akka i win, segwen, iţţagwaden abekkaḍ. Ma tṣebṛem, ţţif i kunwi. Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
4:26: Ibɣa Ṛebbi ad awen Ibeggen, a kwen Iawi d wansayen n wid i kwen id izwaren, a d Iuɣal ɣuṛwen. Ṛebbi d Bab n ṣṣwab, d Amusnaw.
4:27: Ibɣa Ṛebbi ad awen Issuref. Bɣan wid iteddun d lemcihwat, a ţmalem lmil abarar.
4:28: Ibɣa Ṛebbi ad Issifes fellawen. Iţwaxleq umdan d uṛhif.
4:29: A wid iumnen! Ur ţţemyeččat ayla garawen, d aḥerfi, kkes ed ma d ssuq iɣef temwafaqem. Ur neqqet iman nnwen. Ih, Ṛebbi Izga Iţḥunu fellawen.
4:30: Win ixedmen akka, s zzkaṛa akked ddens, deqqal a t Nger ar tmes. Ayagi, izga d ayen isehlen i Ṛebbi.
4:31: Ma tjunbem ayen meqqwṛen, seg wayen i wen iţwakksen, a Nessuref i tucmitin nnwen, a kwen Nessekcem anekcum ukyis.
4:32: Ur ţţasmet, ma Ismenyaf Ṛebbi kra i wiyaḍ. I yirgazen, amur seg wayen kesben; i tlawin, amur seg wayen kesbent. Ssutret i Ṛebbi, si lfeḍl iS. Ih, Ṛebbi Izga Issen yal cci.
4:33: Nerra, i yal wa, iweṛṛaten n wayen d ooan imawlan, llzem, akked wid ukud tɛaqqdem. Efket asen amur nnsen. Ṛebbi Izga Iţwali yal cci.
4:34: Irgazen ad ṣunen tilawin, imi Ismenyafa Ṛebbi kra ɣef kra, ilmend n wayen ţseṛṛifen seg wayla nnsen. Tilawin imaɛnen, iunzen, iţḥaraben ɣef sser n wayen Iḥureb Ṛebbi. Tid sɣuṛ tugadem tuḥsift, nnaɣet ţent, ɛazlet ţent deg imṭeṛḥen, ṛebbit ţent. Ma uɣent awen awal, ur tent ţţawḍet. Ih, Ṛebbi Izga Ɛalay, Meqqweṛ.
4:35: Ma tugadem ad mfaṛaqen, aznet amḥaddi n twacult n neţţa, wayeḍ n twacult n neţţat. Ma bɣan ad mṣalaḥen, a ten Issemɛaceṛ Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga Ɛalay, Iẓṛa.
4:36: Ɛabdet Ṛebbi, ur aS ţcaraket acemma. Elhut ar lwaldin, ar llzem, ar igujilen, ar imeɣban, ar loaṛ i wen iţţilin akked win ur awen neţţili, ar umeddakwel ar yidis, ar iminig, ar waklan nnwen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara amzuxi, imnefxi,
4:37: wid iţcuḥḥun u ţţamṛen i medden ccḥa, iteffren ayen i sen Ifka Ṛebbi, si lfeḍl iS - Nhegga d, i ijehliyen, aɛaqeb isdullun -;
4:38: wid iţṣeṛṛifen ayla nnsen, iwakken a ten id walin medden, ur uminen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru; wid isɛan Cciṭan d amsaɛaf. A yir amsaɛaf!
4:39: Acu ar asen iṛuḥen, lemmer uminen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru, u ṣeṛṛfen seg wayen is iten Iṛẓeq Ṛebbi? Ṛebbi Izga Issen iten.
4:40: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Idennes s wayen iwzen ubelkim. Ma tebbwiḍ d iseɣ, a t Irr d sin, a d Ifk, sɣuṛeS, arraz ameqwṛaḥan.
4:41: Amek, ihi, ma Nusa, si yal lois, s unagi; ma Nusa, yissek, d anagi ɣef wigi?
4:42: Assen, wid ijehlen u ɛuṣan Nnbi, ad ssirmen a ten tesseblaɛ tmurt. Ur teffren awal i Ṛebbi.
4:43: A wid iumnen! Ur ţqeṛṛibet ar tẓallit ma tsekṛem, alamma teẓṛam acu d teqqaṛem. Neɣ ma tellam s loanaba - siwa ma la teţţinigem -, alamma tessardem. Ma tuḍnem neɣ tunagem, neɣ iusa d yiwen segwen si ccicma, neɣ tennulem tilawin, ur tufim aman, ddmet akal zeddigen, sɛaddit eţ ɣef udmawen nnwen d ifassen nnwen. Ih, Ṛebbi Izga Iţqili, Iţsemmiḥ.
4:44: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid iwumi iţţunefk kra si Tezmamt? Pţaɣen d ttelfan, bɣan a ţţennetlafem seg ubrid.
4:45: Ṛebbi Yif akw akken Issen icenga nnwen. Nesteqnaɛ s Ṛebbi d Bab. Nesteqnaɛ s Ṛebbi d Amɛiwen.
4:46: Seg udayen, wid iṭṭeṛṛifen awalen seg inumak nnsen. Qqaṛen: "nesla, naɛṣa, ssemḥes i wayen ur d nnin, muqel aɣ d". Ssaɛwjen ilsawen nnsen, kkaten di ddin. Lemmer, s tideţ, qqaṛen: "nesla, nunez, ssel, muqel aɣ d", war ccekk, yif it i nitni, u iwqem kteṛ. Maca, Ixza ten Ṛebbi, ilmend n tijehli nnsen. Ur ţţamnen, siwa ixeṭṭayen.
4:47: A wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt! Amnet s wayen id Nessers, d atebbet n wayen illan ɣuṛwen, uqbel a Nesɣab udmawen, a ten Nerr ar deffir, neɣ a ten Nexzu, akken Nexza at Ssebt. Lameṛ n Ṛebbi ad iɛaddi.
4:48: Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iţsemmiḥ mara S carken. Iţsemmiḥ ayen nniḍen, i win i S ihwan. Win icurken i Ṛebbi, niɣ ibbwi abekkaḍ abarar.
4:49: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid iran iman nnsen zeddigit? Maca, Ṛebbi Izzizdig win i S ihwan. Ur ţwadensen ula s uclem utemṛiw.
4:50: Wali amek id gren tikerkas ɣef Ṛebbi. Ayagi kan, d abekkaḍ n ṣṣeḥ.
4:51: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid iwumi iţţunefk kra si Tezmamt? Umnen s iṛebbiten n tkerkas, u qqaṛen, i wid ijehlen, ar widak ţwanhan sennig wid iumnen.
4:52: Widak d wid Ixza Ṛebbi. Wid ara Ixzu Ṛebbi, ur asen teţţafeḍ amɛiwen.
4:53: Neɣ sɛan kra si tgelda, dɣa ur ţţaken i medden ula d atemṛiw.
4:54: Neɣ ḥesden medden, deg wayen i sen Ifka Ṛebbi, si lfeḍl iS. Niɣ Nefka, i twacult n Ibṛahim, Tazmamt, ṣṣwab. Nefka yasen tagelda tameqwṛaḥant.
4:55: Segsen wid iumnen yis, segsen wid i ţ iugin. Beṛka ten ajajiḥ n Loahennama.
4:56: Ih, wid inekṛen issekniyen nneɣ, deqqal a ten Nerr ar tmes. Mi ṛɣan igwelman nnsen, ad asen d Nenṣef s igwelman nniḍen, ad jeṛṛben aɛaqeb. Ih, Ṛebbi Izga d Uzmir, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
4:57: Wid iumnen, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Nessekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, din ad wekkṛen, i lebda. I nitni, degsen, tilawin zeddigen; a ten Nawi ar tili isburrun.
4:58: S tideţ, Iumeṛ awen Ṛebbi a ţţerrem lamanat i imawlan nnsent, a ţḥuddem s lmizan, ma tḥuddem ger medden. Ih, ilha wayen uɣuṛ i kwen Iţnabi Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga Issel, Iţwali.
4:59: A wid iumnen! Aɣet awal i Ṛebbi. Aɣet awal i Umazan akked imawlan n lameṛ segwen. Ma temgarradem ɣef lḥaoa, erret eţ ar Ṛebbi akked Umazan, ma tumnen s Ṛebbi akked wass aneggaru. Pţif akka, d ţţawil amxallef.
4:60: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid iumnen, ziɣemma, s wayen ik ed irsen, d wayen id irsen, uqbel ik? Bɣan aḥuddu iṛebbiten n tkerkas, ulamma ţwamṛen a ten nekṛen. Ibɣa Cciṭan a ten itlef ttelfan uɣmiq.
4:61: Ma nnan asen: "aset ed ar wayen id Issers Ṛebbi, akw ar Umazan", a ţwaliḍ ixabiten wexxṛen ak, ugin.
4:62: Amek ihi, ma uɣen tiyta, ilmend n wayen xedmen ifassen nnsen, sinna, a d asen ɣuṛek, ad ggalen s Ṛebbi: "nebɣa kan lewqama akked lembwafqa".
4:63: Widak, Iẓṛa Ṛebbi i illan deg ulawen nnsen. Ihi, ṭṭixeṛ asen, nabi iten, meslay iten, ɣef iman nnsen, s wawal iqenɛen.
4:64: Ur d Nuzen Amazan, siwa kan iwakken ad as aɣen awal, ma Irad Ṛebbi. Wid idensen iman nnsen, ma usan k id, dɣa ssutren ssmaḥ i Ṛebbi, u issuter Umazan ad ţţusemmḥen, ad afen Ṛebbi Issuruf, Iţḥunu.
4:65: Xaṭi! S Mass ik, ur ţţamnen, alamma rran k d amḥaddi, deg wayen iɣef mgarraden. Sinna, ur ţţafen, deg iman nnsen, ara ten ihewwlen, deg wayen id tḥuddeḍ. Ad anzen yal annuz.
4:66: Lemmer i sen Nuri: "mminɣet"! Neɣ "ffɣet seg ixxamen nnwen"! Ur ţ xeddmen, siwa kra segsen. Pţif, i nitni, lemmer xdimen ayen uɣuṛ ţwanecden. D atebbet uṣwib.
4:67: Imiren ad asen Nefk, sɣuṛneɣ, arraz ameqwṛaḥan.
4:69: Wid iţţaɣen awal i Ṛebbi akked Umazan, widak atnan ar wid Iɣat Ṛebbi ger lambiyya, wid issdaqen, ccuhada, ṣṣalḥin. Ay telha tdukli d wigi!
4:70: Wagi d lfeḍl sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Nesteqnaɛ s Ṛebbi d Amusnaw.
4:71: A wid iumnen! Ḥadret iman nnwen! Ẓẓedmet d igrawen, neɣ ẓẓedmet akw.
4:72: Ih, garawen win iţɛaṭṭilen. Ma tuɣem tiyta, ad yini: "Iɣat iyi Ṛebbi, ur lliɣ yidsen, d anagi".
4:73: Ma iusa kwen id lfeḍl sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, ad yini, war ccekk, amzun ur telli tegmaţ garawen: "a lemmer lliɣ yidsen, ad rebḥeɣ rrbeḥ ameqwṛaḥan"!
4:74: Ad nnaɣen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi wid izznuzun tameddurt n ddunit i laxert. Win iţnaɣen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, immut neɣ irbeḥ, ad as Nefk arraz ameqwṛaḥan.
4:75: Acu kwen iuɣen, ula teţnaɣem ara deg ubrid n Ṛebbi? Uṛhifen seg irgazen, tilawin, igwerdan, i la iqqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Ssuffeɣ aneɣ si temdint agi izedɣen imednas. Efk aneɣ d bab sɣuṛeK, Efk aneɣ d asettaṛ sɣuṛeK".
4:76: Wid iumnen ţnaɣen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Wid ijehlen ţnaɣen deg ubrid iṛebbiten n tkerkas. Nnaɣet imeddukwal n Cciṭan. Niɣ tiḥeṛci n Cciṭan d tuṛhift.
4:77: Day ur twalaḍ ara wid iwumi nnan: "brut i ifassen, ẓẓalet, zekkit"? Mi sen iura umennuɣ, arbaɛ, segsen, ugaden imdanen, tugwdi n Ṛebbi, neɣ tugwdi i ţ iɣelben. Qqaṛen: "a Mass nneɣ! Acimi i ɣ Turiḍ amennuɣ? A lemmer i t Teswexxṛeḍ cwiṭ"! Ini: "zzhu n ddunit d amnuc, tif it laxert i win iţḥezziben. Ur teţwadensem ula s yiclem utemṛiw".
4:78: Anda tellam a kwen id taweḍ tmeţţant, xas ma tellam di lebṛuo ioehden. Ma iusa ten id yiseɣ, ad inin: "wagi sɣuṛ Ṛebbi". Ma tusa ten id tucmiţ, ad inin: "tagi sɣuṛek". Ini: "akw sɣuṛ Ṛebbi". Acu iuɣen agdud agi, ur izmir ad ifhem awalen?
4:79: Yal iseɣ i k id iusan, sɣuṛ Ṛebbi. Yal tucmiţ i k id iusan, sɣuṛ iman ik. Nuzen ik id i medden, d Amazan. Nesteqnaɛ s Ṛebbi d Anagi.
4:80: Win iuɣen awal i Umazan, iuɣ awal i Ṛebbi. Win iwexxṛen, ur k id Nuzen d amḥareb nnsen.
4:81: Qqaṛen: "annuz"! Mi k ṭṭaxxṛen, ad iḥekku deg iḍ, urbaɛ segsen, ayen ur d tenniḍ. Ṛebbi Iţţaru ayen ḥekkun deg iḍ. Wexxeṛ asen, ţţkel ɣef Ṛebbi. Nesteqnaɛ s Ṛebbi d Awkil.
4:82: Day ur ţmeyyizen ara Leqwṛan? Lemmer illi si war Ṛebbi, ad afen degs aṭas n wayen imgarraden.
4:83: Ma iusa ten lameṛ n laman neɣ n lxuf, a t berrḥen. Lemmer i t ssawḍen i Umazan akked imawlan n lameṛ nnsen, ad xebṛen wid, segsen, ibɣan ad ẓṛen. Lemmer mačči d lfeḍl n Ṛebbi akked uḥunu S fellawen, a ţţeddum d Cciṭan, siwa kra kan.
4:84: Nnaɣ deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. D iman ik kan ara tkellfeḍ. Efk afud i lmumnin. Izmer Ṛebbi ad Issers tazmert n wid ijehlen. Ṛebbi Yif iten tazmert, Yif iten aɛaqeb.
4:85: Win icefɛan ccafuɛa ilhan, ad iawi, segs, amur. Win icefɛan ccafuɛa icemten, ad iawi, segs, sin imuren. Ṛebbi Izga Issenqad yal cci.
4:86: Ma nnan awen d: "azul"! Erret asen azul it yifen, neɣ erret asen t. Ih, Ṛebbi Izga Iḥeţţeb yal cci.
4:87: Ṛebbi, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa, a kwen Issemlil, ass n tnekra, ur degs ccekk. Anwa i iqqaṛen tideţ sennig Ṛebbi?
4:88: Acu i kwen iuɣen: tebḍam ɣef sin, ɣef ixabiten? Izzaɛ ten Ṛebbi ilmend n wayen kesben. Day tebɣam a ţţenhum win Itlef Ṛebbi? Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur as teţţafeḍ abrid.
4:89: Bɣan a ţţilim d ijehliyen am nitni, a ţţemcabim. Ur sɛut iḥbiben segsen, alamma unagen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi. Ma wexxṛen, ṭṭfet ţen, nnaɣet ţen anda ten tufam, ur sɛut segsen aḥbib neɣ asettaṛ.
4:90: Kkes ed wid iusan ar ugdud ukud tesɛam laɛqed, neɣ i kwen id iusan, gguman wulawen nnsen a kwen nnaɣen, neɣ ad nnaɣen agdud nnsen. Lemmer i S ihwi i Ṛebbi, yili Ifka yasen adabu fellawen, a kwen nnaɣen. Ma ɛazlen iman nnsen segwen, ur kwen nnuɣen, ssutren awen d tifrat, ur kwen Iţţawi Ṛebbi ɣuṛsen.
4:91: A ţţafem wiyaḍ i ibɣan tifrat yidwen, akked tifrat akked ugdud nnsen. Yal tikelt ideg ara ten rren ar lfetna, ad kecmen degs. Ma ur aɛzilen ara iman nnsen segwen, ur awen ssutren ara tifrat, ur fukken ara amennuɣ, ṭṭfet ţen, nnaɣet ţen anda ten tufam. Widak, Nefka yawen fellasen adabu n ṣṣeḥ.
4:92: Ur iţţunefk ara i lmumen ad ineɣ lmumen, siwa ma iɣleḍ. Win inɣan lmumen di leɣwlaḍ, ad iserreḥ i wakli iumnen, a ţţeţţunefk ddeyya i twacult is, siwa ma seddqen ţ. Ma illa seg ugdud acengu nnwen, u neţţa d lmumen, ad iserreḥ i wakli iumnen. Ma illa seg ugdud ukud tesɛam laɛqed, a ţţeţţunefk ddeyya i twacult is, ad iserreḥ i wakli iumnen. Win ur nezmir ara, ad iuẓum sin wagguren, wa deffir wa, d nndama i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Izga Iẓẓeṛ, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
4:93: Win inɣan lmumen s lemɛamda, aqeṭṭi ines d Loahennama, degs ad iwekkeṛ. A d Izɛaf Ṛebbi fellas, a t Ixzu, ad as d Iheggi aɛaqeb abarar.
4:94: A wid iumnen! Ma tennuɣem deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, beggnet iman nnwen. Ur qqaṛet i win i wen d ssutren tifrat: "ur telliḍ d lmumen"! Tebɣam cci n tmeddurt n ddunit. ɣuṛ Ṛebbi, aṭas uɣiti. Akka ay tellam zik. Ṛebbi Ifeṛṛeo fellawen. Beggnet iman nnwen. Ih, Ṛebbi Izga Issen ayen txeddmem.
4:95: Ur aɛdilen ara wid iqqimen si lmumnin, siwa wid iḍṛuṛan, akked wid ijuhden deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen. Ismenyaf Ṛebbi wid ijuhden s wayla nnsen akked yiman nnsen, i wid iqqimen. Akw, Iwaɛɛed asen Ṛebbi ṣṣam. Ifrez Ṛebbi imjuhad af wid iqqimen, s warraz ameqwṛaḥan,
4:96: aseqṛeb ɣuṛeS, ssmaḥ, akked uḥunu. Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
4:97: Ih, i wid iwumi ddment lmalayek leṛwaḥ, u densen iman nnsen, ad inint: "anida tellam"? A d inin: "nella d uṛhifen di tmurt". Ad inint: "day ur tewsiɛ ara tmurt n Ṛebbi, a ţţinigem degs"? Widak, axxam nnsen d Loahennama. A tuɣalin tucmiţ!
4:98: Kkes ed uṛhifen, argaz, tameṭṭut, agrud, ur nezmir i tsensert, ur neţwanhu s abrid.
4:99: Widak, amar Ṛebbi ad asen Isemmeḥ. Ṛebbi Izga Iţqili, Iţsemmiḥ.
4:100: Win iunagen deg ubrid n Ṛebbi, ad iaf, di tmurt, aṭas n ssṛanat akked lufa. Win iffɣen seg uxxam is, d iminig ar Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, sinna, temmuger it tmeţţant, arraz is atan ar Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
4:101: Mi teţţeddum di tmurt, ulac uɣilif ma teẓẓemẓim taẓallit, ma tugadem a d ẓẓedmen fellawen wid ijehlen. Ih, ijehliyen banen d icenga nnwen.
4:102: Ma telliḍ garasen, tezwaṛeḍ asen i tẓallit, ilaq a ţţili terbaɛt, segsen, yidek, s ibeddi, ad ṭṭfen leslaḥ nnsen. Mi knan, ad ilin deffir wen. A d tas terbaɛt nniḍen ur neẓẓul, ad ẓẓalen yidek, ad ḥadren iman nnsen, akked leslaḥ nnsen. Ssarmen wid ijehlen, a ţɣeflem ɣef leslaḥ nnwen akked lqecc nnwen, iwakken a d ẓẓedmen fellawen, yiwet n ẓẓedma. Ulac uɣilif ma tessersem leslaḥ nnwen, ma ihero ikwen ugeffur neɣ tuḍnem. Ḥḥadret iman nnwen. Ih, Ṛebbi Ihegga, i ijehliyen, aɛaqeb isdullun.
4:103: Mi tfukkem taẓallit, mmektit ed Ṛebbi s ibeddi, s iɣimi, s tuẓẓla. Mi teţţuḍemnem, ẓẓalet. Taẓallit, ih, tura i lmumen, s lewqat is.
4:104: Ur fecclet deg uḍfaṛ n ugdud. Ma tmeḥnem, ula d nitni meḥnen am kunwi. Tessaramem, ar Ṛebbi, ayen ur ssaramen. Ṛebbi Izga Iẓṛa, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
4:105: Ih, Nessers ak d Tazmamt, s tideţ, iwakken a ţḥuddeḍ ger imdanen, s wayen i k id Issenɛat Ṛebbi. Ur ţţili d axṣim n lxeyyan.
4:106: Ssuter ssmaḥ i Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
4:107: Ur ţnnaḍaḥ ɣef wid ixeynen iman nnsen. Ṛebbi, s tideţ, ur Iḥemmel ara win ixeynen, idenben.
4:108: Bɣan ad ffren i medden, ur zmiren ad ffren i Ṛebbi. Neţţa Illa yidsen mara d qqaṛen, deg iḍ, awalen iɣef ur Iṛuḍa. Ṛebbi Izga Izzi i wayen xeddmen.
4:109: Atan kunwi tnuḍḥem fellasen, di tmeddurt n ddunit. Anwa ara innaḍḥen Ṛebbi fellasen, ass n tnekra? Neɣ anwa ar yilin fellasen d awkil?
4:110: Win ixedmen cceṛṛ, neɣ idnes iman is, sinna, issuter ssmaḥ i Ṛebbi, ad iaf Ṛebbi Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
4:111: Win ibbwin abekkaḍ, ibbwi it, kan, i iman is. Ṛebbi Izga Iẓṛa, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
4:112: Win ifalṭan neɣ ibbwin abekkaḍ, irra ţ id ɣef wur nexdim, ibbwi lɛaṛ, akked ubekkaḍ n ṣṣeḥ.
4:113: Lemmer mačči d lfeḍl n Ṛebbi fellak, akked uḥunu S, iaɛzem urbaɛ, segsen, a k telfen. Ur tellifan siwa iman nnsen. Ur k ṭṭuṛṛun s wacemma. Issers ak d Ṛebbi Tazmamt akked ṣṣwab. Isselmed ak ayen ur tessineḍ. Izga lfeḍl n Ṛebbi, fellak, d ameqwṛaḥan.
4:114: Aṭas n wayen qqaṛen ur imɛin, siwa ayen iumṛen ssadaqa, neɣ lqanun, neɣ lemṣalḥa ger medden. Win ixedmen aya, issarem ad Iṛaḍi Ṛebbi, deqqal ad as Nefk arraz ameqwṛaḥan.
4:115: Win ixuṣmen Amazan, mbaɛd ma teţwabeggen as d nnhaya, iteddun d ubrid ur d wid n lmumnin, a t Neoo akken iooa. A t Nenheṛ ar Loahennama. A tuɣalin tucmiţ!
4:116: Ih, Ṛebbi ur Iţsemmiḥ ma ad aS carken. Iţsemmiḥ ayen nniḍen, i win i S ihwan. Win icurken i Ṛebbi, innetlef ttelfan uɣmiq.
4:117: La ţnujun ar nnta, war Neţţa. La ţnujun kan ar Cciṭan aballaɣ.
4:118: Ixza t Ṛebbi. Inna: "ad awiɣ amur iţţuḥeţţmen, seg imdanen ik.
4:119: A ten telfeɣ, a ten ssenḥesseɣ, ad asen amṛeɣ ad gezmen imeẓẓuɣen ubeqṛi, ad asen amṛeɣ ad bedlen lxelq n Ṛebbi". Win idmen Cciṭan d bab, war Ṛebbi, ixseṛ lexsaṛa n tideţ.
4:120: Iţɛahad asen, issenḥas iten. Ayen i sen iɛahed Cciṭan, d aɣuṛṛu kan.
4:121: Widak, axxam nnsen d Loahennama, ur ţţafen, segs, tisensert.
4:122: Wid iumnen, u xeddmen ayen ilhan, a ten Nessekcem ar leonanat, ddawat sen isaffen ţţazzalen, degsen ad wekkṛen, i lebda. Lemɛahda n Ṛebbi a ţţeḍṛu. Anwa issawalen tideţ sennig Ṛebbi?
4:123: Ur illi s usirem nnwen, neɣ s win n At Tezmamt. Win ixedmen cceṛṛ, ad iţţuqeṭṭi fellas. Ur Iţţaf, war Ṛebbi, bab neɣ asettaṛ.
4:124: Win ixeddmen ayen ilhan, d ddkeṛ neɣ d nnta, u neţţa iumen…, widak ad kecmen Loennet, ur ţwadensen s yiclem utemṛiw.
4:125: Anwa iṣegmen ddin is sennig win iunzen i Ṛebbi, u neţţa d laɛṣem, u idda d ddin n Ibṛahim, i imalen ar tideţ? Ṛebbi Irra Ibṛahim d aḥbib.
4:126: N Ṛebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ṛebbi Izga Izzi i yal cci.
4:127: Steqsayen k ɣef tlawin. Ini: "Ṛebbi ad awen Issefhem fellasent. Ayen i wen ɣṛan di Tezmamt, ɣef tlawin tigujilin, iwumi ur tefkim ara i sent iuran, u tebɣam a tent taɣem. Akked igwerdan imeẓyanen. A ţbeddem i igujilen s lmizan. Ayen akw txeddmem n lxiṛ, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga Iẓṛa t.
4:128: Ma tugad tmeṭṭut ad as ibru, neɣ ad as iwexxeṛ urgaz is, ulac uɣilif fellasen ma ufan lemwafaqa garasen. Pţif lemwafaqa. Imdanen, deg iman nnsen d imceṛṛiyen. Ma tgerzem u tḥezzbem, Ṛebbi, s tideţ, Izga Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem.
4:129: Ur tezmirem a ţţeddum s lmizan, ger tlawin, xas tebɣam. Ihi, ur ţmalet yal tumlin a ţ teooem, amzun d tamejgugelt. Ma tgam ayen ilhan, u tḥezzbem, s tideţ, Ṛebbi Izga Iţsemmiḥ, Iţḥunu.
4:130: Ma mfaṛaqen, ad Iɣit Ṛebbi yal wa, s ṛṛeẓq iS. Ṛebbi Izga d Ajemmal, d Bab n ṣṣwab.
4:131: N Ṛebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Niɣ Nweṣṣa wid iwumi teţţunefk Tezmamt, uqbel nnwen, u Nweṣṣa kwen, a ţḥezzbem i Ṛebbi. Ma tnekṛem, ihi, n Ṛebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Ṛebbi Izga d Asɛay, d Amaɛzuz.
4:132: N Ṛebbi i illan deg igenwan, i illan di tmurt. Nesteqnaɛ s Ṛebbi d Awkil.
4:133: Ma ihwa yaS, a kwen Ikkes a yimdanen! A d Iawi wiyaḍ. Ṛebbi Izga Izmer i waya.
4:134: Win ibɣan aɣellet n ddunit, ihi, ar Ṛebbi aɣellet n ddunit akked win n laxeṛt. Ṛebbi Izga Issel, Iţwali.
4:135: A wid iumnen! Teddut s lmizan, d inagan n Ṛebbi, xas ɣef yiman nnwen, neɣ imawlan u llzem, ama d ameṛkanti, ama d igellil. Izwar iten Ṛebbi. Ur teddut d lhawiyya, ur twezznem ara. Ma txutlem, neɣ twexxṛem, ihi, Ṛebbi Izga Iẓṛa ayen txeddmem.
4:136: A wid iumnen! Amnet s Ṛebbi akked Umazan iS, akked Tezmamt id Issers i Umazan iS, akked Tezmamt id Issers, uqbel. Win inekṛen Ṛebbi, lmalayek iS, Tizmamin iS, imazanen iS, akked wass aneggaru, ihi innetlaf ttelfan uɣmiq.
4:137: Ih, wid iumnen, sinna, nekṛen, sinna, umnen, sinna, nekṛen, sinna, zaden di nnkeṛ, ur sen Iţsemmiḥ Ṛebbi, ur ten Iţţawi d ubrid.
4:139: Wid iţţaran ijehliyen d iḥbiben, war lmumnin, day ssarmen ɣuṛsen tazmert? Tazmert, s tideţ, ar Ṛebbi yakw.
4:140: Niɣ Nessers awen d, di Tezmamt: "ma teslam la nekṛen issekniyen n Ṛebbi, la ttihin fellasen, ur ţɣimit yidsen, alamma bedlen ameslay. Mulac a ţţilim am nitni". Ṛebbi, s tideţ, a d Issemlil ixabiten akked ijehliyen di Loahennama, meṛṛa.
4:141: Wid i kwen iquṛɛan, ma Ifka yawen d Ṛebbi lɣelb, a d inin: "day ur nella ara yidwen"? Ma illa wayen rebḥen ijehliyen, ad inin: "day ur nḥuṛeb ara fellawen, nsellek ikwen si lmumnin"? Ad Iḥudd Ṛebbi garawen, ass n tnekra. Ur Iţţara ara Ṛebbi, i ijehliyen, abrid ar lmumnin.
4:142: Ih, ixabiten xedɛen Ṛebbi. D Neţţa iten Ixedɛan. Ma kren d i tẓallit, a d kren d imaɛguza, akken kan a ten id walin medden. Cwiṭ kan id smektayen Ṛebbi.
4:143: Ur banen akka, neɣ akka; ɣeṛ wigi, neɣ ɣeṛ wiyaḍ. Win Itlef Ṛebbi ur as teţţafeḍ abrid, d awezɣi.
4:144: A wid iumnen! Ur ţţarat ijehliyen d iḥbiben, war lmumnin. Day tebɣam ad aS tefkem, i Ṛebbi, adabu ibanen, mgal kwen?
4:145: Ih, ixabiten di lqaɛa n wadda n tmes, ur asen teţţafeḍ asettaṛ.
4:146: Kkes ed wid ituben, ixeddmen ayen ilhan, iṭṭfen di Ṛebbi, izzazdgen ddin nnsen ar Ṛebbi. Widak, ad ilin ar lmumnin. Deqqal a d Iawi Ṛebbi, i lmumnin, arraz ameqwṛaḥan.
4:147: Acu ara Ixdem Ṛebbi s uɛaqeb nnwen, ma tesnemmrem, tumnem? Niɣ Ṛebbi Iţţara tajmilt, Iẓṛa.
